sources: datasheets/ASM2464PD-PDX-PCB-Guideline-Mid-loss-R1.0.pdf pages 5-6: short power wiring, 15:8 mil power geometry, L3/L4 power and L2/L5 ground
datasheets/ASM2464PDX_TI_R03.pdf sheet 6: HDDPC switched slot power and source-to-gate RC networks
viaProcess: Full-stack drilled vias, filled and copper capped where in pad; existing fabrication process
connectivityScope: Both ATX 12 V source contacts, every physical switch source/drain pad, all five 12 V and three 3.3 V slot power contacts, all 69 PCIe ground contacts, capacitor banks, both source-to-gate RC networks, both drivers, HDDPC pulldown, both discharge resistors and ATX PS_ON link

dcScreen.scope: Separate input and output conductor networks at equal current per physical pad. MOSFET loss is reported separately using 25 C maximum Rds; currents are individual rail envelopes, not permission to exceed 75 W combined. No voltage acceptance inferred from unspecified source/cable/bridge loads.

qualification.remaining: Startup/shutdown MOSFET SOA, hot Rds and junction temperature, actual card capacitance, gate-resistor repeated pulse stress, input voltage/cable loss, shared VCCH load, ground return, fault clearing and fabrication process acceptance. The reference circuit has no active current limit or enforced 75 W combined limit. Existing bridge 3 A / 8 mV qualification remains open.

hddpcLocalCrossingPurpose: L3 crossings over the L4 flash and buck input supplies, using full-stack drilled vias. Keep both supply feeds continuous and retain the original 5 V DC screen.

surfaceCopperRevision.scope: Requested steps 1–3; copper and via changes only. Component positions and power-switch parts remain fixed.
surfaceCopperRevision.stitchSelection: tscircuit native ViaStitchSolver; selected sites are authored explicitly before native copper-pour generation
surfaceCopperRevision.referencePlanePolicy: Only new via antipads may remove L2/L5 GND; existing high-speed trace projections must remain supported.
surfaceCopperRevision.qualification: Conductor improvement only. Full-path hot resistance, contacts, ground return, startup/shutdown SOA, transients and thermal behavior remain open.

innerCopperRevision.scope: Widen input headers and add a parallel L3 output corridor around the restrictive surface path. MOSFET and BOM unchanged.
innerCopperRevision.regulatorPlaneReservation: VCCL L3 plane reserves 0.225 mm to the left slot-power bypass. Its bridge and bypass continuity require revalidation.
innerCopperRevision.bottomCrossbarResult: Existing control traces interrupt the direct bottom connection. The trial branch reduces the coarse output result by only 0.028 mV.

localCoreWidthRepair.scope: Local SLOT_12V copper widening and adjacent VDD reservation beside the REFCLK and CC1 via clearances. Existing CC1 keepouts and validation limits remain active.
